_about: break-ui data for tools/check.mjs --worst-case. Each scenario starts from closet.json (or another scenario) and changes only the data, never the app. Names are realistic user input in French, Tagalog and Hindi, with emoji, a one-letter name, extra spaces and an unbroken word.
